subject: How to make a reactive function work?

messages.author: 9e5b6647683ad4a8
messages.subject: How to make a reactive function work?
parts:
Hello guys i created R as a reactive function in the code above but when i try to use it as R() it doesn work.
"Operation not allowed without an active reactive context. ", 
                "(You tried to do something that can only be done from inside a ", 
                "reactive expression or observer.)")
Any ideas?








shinyServer(
  function(input, output,session){
   
    
   R <- reactive({subset(DatabaseEuroleague,(Year==input$selectARCYe))})

col_pal <- brewer.pal(7, "Set1")
col_black <- rgb(0, 0, 0, 0.2)
dat <- subset(R(),
              select = -c(FGPerc,TwoPPerc,ThreePPerc,FTPerc,TOT))

mat <- as.data.frame(subset(dat, select = -c(Year,Name,Team)))

MAT <- na.exclude(mat)
DAT <- na.exclude(dat)
set.seed(4321)
as <- stepArchetypes(MAT, k = 1:10)

rss(as)
screeplot(as)

messages.author: ca443e6eaa0e78ed
messages.subject: Re: How to make a reactive function work?
parts:
You can't access R() or any other reactive unless you are inside one of:
  • reactive({...})  [ for calculating a value ]
  • output$foo <- renderXXX({...})  [ for displaying the result ]
  • observe({...})  [ for performing some kind of action ]
The reason for this is because accessing a reactive outside of one of those contexts is almost always a bug--and indeed, in your case it is.

In the following code I've added the proper renderPlot and also got rid of your set.seed and replaced it with repeatable(), which will ensure that the rest of your R session is not affected:

col_pal <- brewer.pal(7, "Set1")
      col_black <- rgb(0, 0, 0, 0.2)
      dat <- subset(R(),
        select = -c(FGPerc,TwoPPerc,ThreePPerc,FTPerc,TOT))
      
      mat <- as.data.frame(subset(dat, select = -c(Year,Name,Team)))
      
      MAT <- na.exclude(mat)
      DAT <- na.exclude(dat)

as <- repeatable(stepArchetypes, 4321)(MAT, k = 1:10)
      
      rss(as)
      screeplot(as)
    })

messages.subject: Re: How to make a reactive function work?
parts: Sounds right,but if i want to affect the rest of my code in order to create plots and data tables from the results that this algorithm gives?Basically from the R() depends almost everything in my code.Thanks again!

shinyServer(
  function(input, output,session){
  
    R <- reactive({subset(DatabaseEuroleague,(Year==input$selectARCYe))})
    
    output$plot <- renderPlot({
      col_pal <- brewer.pal(7, "Set1")
      col_black <- rgb(0, 0, 0, 0.2)
      dat <- subset(R(),
                    select = -c(FGPerc,TwoPPerc,ThreePPerc,FTPerc,TOT))
      
      mat <- as.data.frame(subset(dat, select = -c(Year,Name,Team)))
      
      MAT <- na.exclude(mat)
      DAT <- na.exclude(dat)
     
        as <- repeatable(stepArchetypes, 4321)(MAT, k = 1:10)

rss(as)                                                                               (LINECHART)                                                        
      screeplot(as)
      
    })
    a4 <- bestModel(as[[4]])
    parameters(a4)
    barplot(a4, MAT, percentiles = TRUE)                                     (BARPLOT)
    players <- function(which) {
      players <- list()
      players$which <- which
      players$MAT <- MAT[which, ]
      players$coef <- coef(a4, "alphas")[which, ]
      players$DAT <- DAT[which, ]
      
      players
    }
    which <- apply(coef(a4, "alphas"), 2, which.max)
    atypes <- players(which)
    
    cbind(subset(atypes$DAT, select = c(Year,Name,Team)),            (DATATABLE 1)
          atypes$coef)
    good_players <- function(atype, threshold) {
      which<- which(coef(a4, "alphas")[, atype] > threshold)
      
      good_coef <- coef(a4, "alphas")[which, ]
      good_DAT <- subset(DAT[which, ], select = c(Year,Name,Team))
      good_DAT <- cbind(good_DAT, good_coef)
      good_DAT <- good_DAT[order(-good_coef[, atype]), ]
      
      good_DAT
    }
    
    
    good_threshold <- 0.8
    
    players <- lapply(1:4, good_players, good_threshold)                      (DATATABLE 2)
    players
